successors.name: Kalabhra dynasty
successors.text: the Chola country on the Kaveri, which the Kalabhras 'invaded Tamil country, displaced the existing kingdoms and ruled'

ledger.x: c. 180: Kongu passes to the Cheras. Chera page: Chenguttuvan 'c. 180 CE' (or 'either the first or the last quarter of the second century CE'); under him 'Chera territory covered the Malabar Coast and the Kongu country'. The counterpart is my reading: Cliopatria holds Karur and Coimbatore in the Chola shape.

c. 305: the Early Cholas end. The page is silent on the date: it puts the end of the Sangam age at 'c. 300', says the Kalabhras 'invaded Tamil country, displaced the existing kingdoms' without a date, and that the Cholas 'disappeared from the Tamil land almost completely in this debacle'. The year is Cliopatria's last…

certainty.note: The Sangam kingdoms have no recorded frontiers; the Chola country is 'watered by the river Kaveri' on the pages.
